Header: Meloidogyne graminicola Nel ver mudichu noorpuzhu

Prevention: Crop rotation with marygold, castor, cowpea, soybean, sesame and onion.
Adapt a two month fallow period in summer in a yearly crop plan.
Eclipta alba and incorporate in the field.
Selection of resistant varieties such as
IR 32, TKM-6, Patnai, Monohar, Sali and
Soil solarization with polythene sheets for three weeks (35-60°C).
Crop rotation with non-host crop such as groundnut and maize.
Monitoring: Monitor crops regularly, notably on a weekly basis during growth periods.
Symptoms include hooked-like gall on roots, distorted growth of young leaves, yellowing on young plants, premature flowering and formation of panicles.
Other symptoms include poorly filled grains in panicles and chlorosis of leaves.
Consider direct control actions as soon as symptoms are observed on crops.
Direct Control: Basal application of neem cake (80 kg per acre).
Restrictions: Always wear protective clothing when handling pesticides, follow product label instructions.
